instruction: Architectural Drawing Set by Tags Build a small architectural model and organize it into 4 named Tags so that distinct scenes can filter what is drawn on screen. There is no initial file - model everything from scratch. Specification: - Build 4 named tag-groups. Every geometry in the scene must belong to exactly one tag and its `<geometry>` `name`/`id` must start with the tag prefix followed by an underscore: - `Arch` - architectural shell (walls, roof, floor, etc.). At least one geometry named `Arch_*`. - `Furn` - furniture. At least one geometry named `Furn_*`. - `Plumb` - plumbing. At least one geometry named `Plumb_*`. - `Elec` - electrical. At least one geometry named `Elec_*`. - Produce 4 scenes, each with a specific tag-visibility subset: - `Scene_Arch` - only `Arch` visible. - `Scene_Plumb` - `Arch` + `Plumb` visible. - `Scene_Elec` - `Arch` + `Elec` visible. - `Scene_All` - all 4 tags visible. - Since COLLADA has no native SketchUp tag/scene concept, emit a sidecar JSON `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes.json` describing the scenes exactly with this schema: ``` { "scenes": [ {"name": "Scene_Arch", "visible_tags": ["Arch"]}, {"name": "Scene_Plumb", "visible_tags": ["Arch", "Plumb"]}, {"name": "Scene_Elec", "visible_tags": ["Arch", "Elec"]}, {"name": "Scene_All", "visible_tags": ["Arch", "Furn", "Plumb", "Elec"]} ] } ``` - Produce a full-scene export `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` with all 4 tag-groups present. - Produce per-scene DAE exports containing **only the geometry of the visible tags** for each scene (excluded tag geometries must be physically absent from the file): - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_Arch.dae` - contains `Arch_*` geometry only. - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_Plumb.dae` - contains `Arch_*` and `Plumb_*` geometries only. - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_Elec.dae` - contains `Arch_*` and `Elec_*` geometries only. - `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output_All.dae` - contains all 4 tag-groups (same content as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae`). Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes.json` is valid JSON and matches the schema - `scenes` is a list of 4 entries with the expected `name`/`visible_tags` values (order-insensitive for the tags within each entry). 2. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.dae` parses as valid COLLADA and contains >= 1 geometry for each of the 4 tag prefixes (`Arch_*`, `Furn_*`, `Plumb_*`, `Elec_*`). 3. Each per-scene DAE parses as valid COLLADA. 4. Each per-scene DAE contains at least one geometry for every visible tag listed in `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scenes.json` for that scene. 5. Each per-scene DAE contains NO geometry whose name starts with an excluded tag prefix (substantive check - not just the sidecar JSON). [Software] Launch SketchUp with `C:\SketchUp 2026 26.0.429 x64 En Portable\SketchUp.exe` (adjust if your install differs).
